analyzed_vuln.description: `iterateCIPRanks()` stores per-atom CIP entries in vectors that are only `reserve(16)`d, not sized. Later it writes by index (`cipEntries[i][numIts + 1] = ranks[i]`) assuming the entry has at least `numIts+2` elements. For crafted molecules from pickle deserialization, an entry can be shorter than that at a later iteration, so this unchecked indexed write goes past the vector’s current size and triggers ASan container-overflow.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: The fuzzer feeds attacker-controlled pickle bytes to `MolPickler::molFromPickle()`, which builds a `ROMol` and then calls `MolOps::assignStereochemistry()` (legacy path) for older pickle versions. This reaches `assignAtomCIPRanks()` -> `iterateCIPRanks()`. A malformed but parseable molecule that keeps the CIP iteration loop running (`numIts` increases) while at least one `cipEntries[i]` does not grow to `numIts+2` causes the out-of-bounds vector write at line ~969.
